newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on CBOT-sparked local selling.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on CBOT-sparked local selling.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended down on commission, fund and local selling, traders said.

"Renewed weakness in the U.S. caused locals to sell and some fund and commission selling. Cargill bought 1,000 Jan," a trader said. Nov-Jan spread at $5, Jan-Mar $3.70, Nov-May $13.50, Mar-May $3, May-Nov $29.50. November futures crush margin rose to -30.09 from -31.37 Thursday. Volume was heavy at 7,315 lots, or 146,300 tonnes, with 500 hedges.
November canola fell $2.70 to $383.30 and January lost $2 to $390.10. March, May, July, August and November set new lows.
November flax rose to unchanged at $352 on commercial market close buying. Nov-Jan spread at $4.50, Nov-Mar $8. Volume was 1,000 lots. Oats and peas did not trade.
November western barley lost $1 to $135.50 on commercial and hedge selling. Commission houses sold February down $1.50 to $139.20. Nov-Feb spread $2, May-July at even money. Volume was 2,500 lots.
December feed wheat lost $3.40 to $162.20 as Alberta Wheat Pool sold to locals, commercials, traders said. Dec-Mar spread at even money, Mar-July at $0.50, May-July at even money.
(All values in Canadian dollars except peas, oats).
